'''Crovan Dane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a galactic conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Crovan Dane was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of the [[Jedi]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Before completing his training, Dane abandoned his position in the Order after a confrontation with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Disillusioned, Dane left the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and sought transportation offworld. Piloting a ship away from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Dane made his living as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TWOTJ" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was present on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the events leading up to the [[Battle of Akoshissss]]. He was trying to make a delivery of wildlife to the Separatist agent [[Bitt Panith]] when a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were forced onto his shuttle to be sold as slaves. His partner, [[Tahnchukka]], a grey-furred Wookiee, did not object and helped him to smuggle the beings offworld.<ref name="TWOTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Because of the nature of the story ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]'', multiple endings are possible. In one ending, Crovan Dane is eaten by a [[Terentatek/Legends|Terentatek]], while in another he makes the delivery and repays [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] with the cash Panith gave him. In another he takes [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Jaylen Kos]] as a partner and together they execute [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin's]] [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|Padawan]]. In another he is arrested and probably killed by Ziro and [[Goomi]] or else he is injured by Goomi and rejoins the Jedi Order.<ref name="TWOTJ" />
